# Hellhound Spectral White AMD RadeonTM RX 7900 XT 20GB GDDR6
## RX7900XT 20G-L/OC/WHITE
### Spectral White Edition: Redefining Elegance in Gaming Tech

The RX 7900 XT Hellhound Spectral White Edition stands as a pinnacle of design in the world of graphics cards. It boasts a harmonious all-white PCB and heatsink, creating a sleek, unified aesthetic that's a first in the industry. This card is more than just a powerhouse of performance; it's a centerpiece that will elevate the look of any gaming setup.

Beneath its sleek exterior lies the same raw power and performance that the Hellhound series is renowned for. With state-of-the-art cooling, lightning-fast clock speeds, and a unique LED lighting system with three modes - blue, white, and off, controlled via a physical switch - this edition promises to deliver an unparalleled gaming experience.
1. Metal Reinforced Backplate
2. Dual BIOS
5. Brand New Amethyst LED Color
6. Optimum Heatpipe Arrangement
7. Ring-fan Blade Design
Dual ball bearings reduce rotational friction, providing excellent heat dissipation and effectively doubling the expected lifetime of the fans.
### Intelligent Fan Controller

Utilizing temperature detection from a smart chip, fans will start running when the GPU reaches 60°C and shut down below 50°C. Efficient cooling, fan-noise reduction, and extended product lifetime are all benefits of a more accurate temperature monitoring.
### Unprecedented Ring-fan Blade Design

The newest 9-blade design of our fans generate better airflow and air pressure under the same noise level, improving cooling performance to reduce GPU temperatures by more than 3°C compared to previous generations.

A brand new white heatsink with closely spaced vertical fins is mounted on the PCB, offering a larger heat-spreading area and improved heat radiation. This allows airflow to efficiently disperse heat.
### Turbulence Reducing Fan Rotation

The middle fan spins in the reverse way so as to reduce the air turbulence between neighboring fans when drawing in cool air. The mechanism therefore maximizes the air flow and pressure when less turbulence occurs to offset, further to lower the noise level without sacrificing the cooling efficiency.
### Optimum Heatpipe Arrangement
A set of 8 x 6φ fresh new white nickel-plated copper heatpipes align closely above the PCB to more quickly and effectively transfer heat from the GPU and VRAM to the cooling array.

Hellhound adopts a 10+3+1 phase VRM design with DrMOS to power the GPU as well as an additional 2+1 phase specifically designated for the VRAM. New IMON technology monitors and reports the electric current and power consumption on each individual phase. By balancing the workload, the Hellhound ensures unparalleled stability and thermal protection during overclocking. In addition, high quality car-grade polymer capacitors features long-lasting durability and high conductivity lowers power loss during transmission.
A robust metal bracket is installed on the side of the PCB and is supported all the way to the I/O plate, making the card stand firmly in place inside the chassis.
### Metal Reinforced Backplate

The metal backplate strengthens and protects the internal components from PCB bend, and a cut-out design on the back plate allows exhaust heat to properly flow through for heat-dissipation efficiency.
### Ice Blue and Glacier White LED Color

Hellhound of this generation now comes with two LED color options. Gamers are able to choose the color they want by flipping the switch on side of the card. Ice blue shows the Hellhound's coolness, while glacial white projects a crisp, calm, elegance.
### Dual BIOS Mode

Hellhound RX 7900 XT features Dual BIOS built-in and a switch for easy swapping. -OC BIOS: A boosted mode that increases fan RPM to keep your card operating at a lower temperature to drive higher performance. -Silent BIOS: Focused on lower noise and fan longevity, a milder fan speed, trading fan speed and noise for moderate, but still controlled, temperatures while maintaining performance.
